notes: AUTHORED combos. Every entry was either walked by hand against card text and the Core Rules (status 'verified') or proposed by the Phase 0 hunt and not yet human-reviewed (status 'candidate'). Nothing here is inferred by code.
Cards are base codes (no alt-art suffix). quantity is a multiset requirement. needs/produces link combos into a DAG that src/combos.ts flattens into Variants.
rulesVersion is the Core Rules 'Last Updated' date the walk was done against.

combos.name: Forge / Ekko recycle loop — infinite Energy

uses.note: Kill this: Recycle up to 4 cards from trashes. Its play trigger makes a Recruit each pass.
[Deathknell] — Recycle me to ready your runes.
Draw 2. One in hand, one in the trash at loop start.
Reaction; kills Ekko as its cost, draws 2, channels the recycled rune back. One in hand, one in the trash at loop start.

easy: Legend domains cover Mind and Order (Lady of Luminosity, Herald of the Arcane, Chem-Baroness, Deceiver).
notable: Main Deck EMPTY — the deck draws itself out first; every card not in the loop must be in hand or trash.
12 runes in play (the deck's whole Rune Deck channeled); at least one Mind rune.
Forge of the Future in play; one Shadow's Call and one Sacrifice already in the trash.

steps: Activate Forge of the Future (Kill this): recycle Forge itself, a Shadow's Call and a Sacrifice from the trash. Deck: 3 cards.
Play Ekko, Recurrent for 5 Energy + 1 Mind Power. Pay the Power by recycling an EXHAUSTED Mind rune (rule 164.2.b has no exhaust in its cost).
Play Shadow's Call (2 Energy) on any friendly unit. In response play Sacrifice (1 Energy, Reaction) killing Ekko as its cost. Exhaust every still-ready rune for floating Energy first.
Ekko's Deathknell resolves: recycle Ekko (deck: 4 cards) and ready all 11 runes on the board.
Sacrifice resolves: draw 2, channel the recycled rune back exhausted (12 runes again). Shadow's Call resolves: draw 2. Hand now holds Forge, Shadow's Call, Sacrifice, Ekko.
Play Forge (2 Energy) — its play trigger makes a 1 Might Recruit at your base. Repeat from step 1.
combos.netPerIteration: -10 Energy -1 Power spent; 11 runes readied and 1 channeled back; +1 floating Energy and +1 Recruit token per pass. Unbounded.
combos.terminatesIn: infinite energy (engine); infinite Recruits at base

sources.title: Analyzing Infinite Combo Lux — Riftbound's Hottest New Deck (Scott Mines, TCGplayer Infinite)
riftbound.gg Lux legend guide (Tianjin 19th/640, Hartford top 8)
Hand walk against Core Rules 2026-07-16 (docs/phase0-findings.md Result 5)

combos.name: Retreat / Lecturing Yordle — infinite Power

uses.note: Recycles Forge + Retreat each pass.
Return a friendly unit to hand; its owner channels 1 rune exhausted — brings back the rune recycled for Power.
When you play me, draw 1. Drawn and replayed twice per pass.

easy: Legend domains cover Mind and Order.
notable: Infinite Energy already established (this loop spends 9 Energy per Power).

steps: Recycle a rune to float 1 Power of its domain (legal at any priority, rule 429.3 / 164.2.b).
Kill Forge of the Future to recycle Forge and Retreat. Deck: 2 cards.
Play Lecturing Yordle (3 Energy): draw 1.
Play Retreat (1 Energy) on Lecturing Yordle: it returns to hand and you channel the recycled rune back exhausted.
Replay Lecturing Yordle (3 Energy): draw the remaining card. Replay Forge (2 Energy). Repeat.
Weave any other trash card into Forge's recycle to rebuild a perfect hand.
combos.netPerIteration: -9 Energy, +1 floating Power of any rune domain you control. Unbounded given infinite Energy.

combos.name: Renata Glasc, Mastermind bounce — score to 8

uses.note: 4 Energy + 4 Mind Power, exhaust: Score 1 point. Only while at a battlefield.
Returns Renata to hand so she can be replayed and re-readied.
When a unit you control becomes Mighty, pay 1 Order Power to ready it. Renata enters exhausted (143.4).
Buffs each unit played this turn so Renata (4 Might) enters at 5 and becomes Mighty.

easy: Legend domains cover Mind and Order.
You control a battlefield to play Renata to.
notable: Rally the Troops resolved this turn.

steps: Play Renata Glasc, Mastermind to a battlefield you control. Rally the Troops buffs her to 5 Might: she becomes Mighty.
Fiora, Worthy triggers: pay 1 Order Power to ready Renata.
Pay 4 Energy + 4 Mind Power and exhaust Renata: score 1 point (ability-granted, not capped by rule 470).
Play Retreat on Renata: she returns to hand (a new object — rule 124 — so she becomes Mighty again on re-entry).
Repeat until you pass the Victory Score.
combos.netPerIteration: 1 point per ~10 Energy + 5 Power. Bounded only by the infinite engines feeding it.

sources.title: Analyzing Infinite Combo Lux (TCGplayer Infinite), Stage 4.3

combos.notes: Any other repeatable ready would replace Fiora + Rally the Troops; this is the line the tournament deck used.

combos.name: Stealthy Pursuer / Eye of the Herald — infinite ready Recruits

uses.note: When a friendly unit moves from my location, I may be moved with it. BANNED in Constructed since 2026-07-24.
Equipment. Effect granted to the equipped unit: When I move, play a 1 Might Recruit unit token here.
Your tokens enter ready.

easy: Legend domains cover Chaos and Order (Heart of the Tempest).
A battlefield you control, so moves never open a combat.
notable: Eye of the Herald attached to Stealthy Pursuer (1 Order Power).
One ready unit at Stealthy Pursuer's location to start.

steps: A ready friendly unit Standard-Moves from Stealthy Pursuer's location to your battlefield (or back to base), exhausting itself (rule 144.2).
Stealthy Pursuer's trigger moves him along. This is not a Standard Move, so he does not exhaust.
Eye of the Herald's granted effect fires on Pursuer: play a 1 Might Recruit here. Renata Glasc, Industrialist makes it enter ready.
That Recruit Standard-Moves back the other way; Pursuer follows; another ready Recruit appears. Repeat.
combos.netPerIteration: +1 ready Recruit per move; no resources spent.
combos.terminatesIn: infinite ready Recruits (engine); wins through Conquer, Hold, or The Grand Plaza

sources.title: Riot Games — July Ban List Updates: "the potential to create infinite Recruits as early as turn three"
Piltover Archive — Vendetta rules update coverage

combos.notes: Kept although banned: legality is a dated, format-scoped fact the matcher reports, not a reason to delete the combo.

combos.name: Ahri, Alluring × Blue Sentinel — multiplied Hold points

uses.note: When I hold, you score 1 point.
Your hold effects for holding here trigger an additional time.

easy: Legend domains cover Calm and Mind (Nine-Tailed Fox).
notable: Hold one battlefield through your Beginning Phase with N Ahri and K Blue Sentinel there.
Points per Hold: 1 + N × (1 + K). N=2, K=2 gives 7.

steps: Establish and keep control of a battlefield with N copies of Ahri, Alluring and K copies of Blue Sentinel present.
At your Beginning Phase you Hold: score 1 (rule 470 cap) and each Ahri's hold trigger fires 1 + K times.
combos.terminatesIn: burst of ability points in one Hold
combos.notes: Load-bearing reading: card text (Golden Rule 002) lets Blue Sentinel add trigger instances despite 471.2.c. Pending human review.

combos.name: Tryndamere, Barbarian × Red Brambleback — multiplied Conquer points

uses.note: When I conquer after an attack, if you assigned 5 or more excess damage to enemy units, you score 1 point.
Your conquer effects for conquering here trigger an additional time.

notable: Move Tryndamere and the Bramblebacks (not play them) onto an enemy battlefield with a thin garrison so the excess-damage clause is met.

steps: Standard-Move Tryndamere and K Red Bramblebacks from base to an enemy-held battlefield; win the combat with 5+ excess damage.
Conquer: score 1 (rule 470) and Tryndamere's conquer trigger fires 1 + K times.
combos.terminatesIn: burst of ability points in one Conquer

combos.name: The Grand Plaza + Recruit the Vanguard — seven units, win

uses.note: When you hold here, if you have 7+ units here, you win the game.
Play four 1 Might Recruit unit tokens (to your base or battlefields you control).

easy: Mono-Order: any Order legend. The Grand Plaza is domainless.
notable: The Grand Plaza must be the battlefield in play — random in Duel (1 of 3), chosen in Match.
Survive one opponent turn with 7+ units on it.

steps: Control The Grand Plaza. Resolve Recruit the Vanguard placing the Recruits there (twice, or with other token makers) until 7+ units are present.
Hold at your Beginning Phase: you win the game (rule 195).

combos.name: Gutter Palace — exactly 4 and 4

uses.note: At the start of your Beginning Phase, if you have exactly 4 cards in hand and exactly 4 units at battlefields, you win the game. Discard 1, exhaust: play a 1 Might Bird token.

notable: End your turn at exactly 4 cards in hand and exactly 4 units at battlefields; its own ability tunes both counts at once.

steps: Play Gutter Palace (gear enters ready). Adjust with its discard/exhaust ability: hand −1, units at battlefields +1.
Pass at 4/4. At the start of your next Beginning Phase the check fires: you win.
